# JTL Growth

> JTL Growth is an AI and automation agency based in Caloocan, Metro Manila, Philippines, founded in July 2026 by Jamz Jamorol. It builds AI and automation systems scoped to client goals: AI agents, CRM and workflow automation, business process systems, and custom web builds. Pricing is quote-based: you name the outcome, we quote the build. Serving Philippine and international businesses.

- Site: https://jtlgrowth.com/
- Founder: Jamz Jamorol (https://jtlgrowth.com/jamz-jamorol/ · https://www.linkedin.com/in/jamzjamorol)
- Location: Caloocan, Metro Manila, Philippines
- Registered: DTI Business Name No. 8378934 (legal name: JTLGROWTH COMPUTER PROGRAMMING SERVICES), Philippines, 2026
- Facebook: https://www.facebook.com/jtlgrowth
- Instagram: https://www.instagram.com/jtlgrowth
- Homepage: hero, an About Me section on the founder, and a contact/booking section; links out to every page below.
- Services (https://jtlgrowth.com/services/): the four-tier ladder, built in order: Tier 1 Funnels & Websites, Tier 2 Automation Systems, Tier 3 AI Employees, Tier 4 Ops Portals.
- Products (https://jtlgrowth.com/products/): things you can get or install today: Inbox Scout, The AI Employee, the Growth software demo, JTL AgentKit, Scout packs, and Robots & Coffee (off-site storefront).
- Workshop (https://jtlgrowth.com/workshop/): a two-day, hands-on founder AI workshop: build a working AI employee and give it a UI system.
- Work (https://jtlgrowth.com/work/): case studies of shipped, live systems: FWIB, this site, AVAS Night Shift, Robots & Coffee.
- Growth software demo (https://jtlgrowth.com/growth/): screen recordings of the AI operations HQ the agency runs on.
- What we do: custom AI and automation systems (AI agents, workflow automation, CRM automation, business process systems, websites and landing pages), quote-based pricing.
- Contact: booking via the site's main call-to-action.

## Jamz Jamorol (founder)

Profile page: https://jtlgrowth.com/jamz-jamorol/

Jamz Jamorol is a Filipino systems builder and electrical engineer based in Caloocan City, National Capital Region, Philippines. He is the founder of JTL Growth, a web development and growth studio, and the Co-Founder of AVAS (Ayala Virtual Assistance Services). He designs and builds AI agents, workflow and CRM automation, client ops portals, lead generation engines, and custom web systems, and runs his own agency on the AI operations system he designed himself.

- Full name: Jamz Jamorol
- Roles: Founder, JTL Growth · Co-Founder, AVAS (Ayala Virtual Assistance Services, est. 2025) · Co-Founder, VFJ Low Voltage Builders (construction, low-voltage systems, IT services)
- Based in: Caloocan City, National Capital Region, Philippines
- Founded: JTL Growth (2026), DTI Business Name No. 8378934
- Education: Electrical Engineering, Polytechnic University of the Philippines (graduating September 2026)
- Expertise: AI agents, multi-agent systems, business process automation, workflow and CRM automation, GoHighLevel, web development, low-voltage systems
- Clients served: Philippines, United States, Europe, Australia
- LinkedIn: https://www.linkedin.com/in/jamzjamorol

Note: JTL Growth is an independent Philippine agency. It is not affiliated with JTL-Software (the German e-commerce ERP company).
